findings.title: Triple-stash this.key/this.value renders notification data unescaped in emails
findings.description: The notification email template renders caller-provided key/value pairs with a Handlebars triple-stash ({{{ }}}), which disables HTML escaping. A value containing markup is emitted verbatim into the rendered email body, allowing HTML injection into messages delivered to recipients.
findings.impact: An attacker-controlled free-text field is rendered as raw HTML in notification emails, enabling content spoofing or phishing against recipients.
findings.exploit_scenario: An authenticated user sets a free-text field to markup. When a target-added notification is generated, the triple-stash renders the markup unescaped in the recipient's email.
findings.recommendation: Render the value with a double-stash ({{ }}) so Handlebars escapes it, or sanitize the field before templating.
preconditions: An authenticated user can set the free-text field that feeds this template value.
The getValuePairData helper that populates key/value pairs is defined in the consuming email service, which is not part of this repository.

scope.application: [Library] Notification email templates consumed by downstream email services
